question: Site/cell actual topology
requiredOwnerRoles: Capacity and platform owners; Site/platform architect
requiredEvidence: As-built dependency map and witnessed failure coverage. Approved service envelope with binding bottleneck and growth trigger.

question: Zone-authority and co-residency
requiredOwnerRoles: Security authority and platform architect; Security authority and service owners
requiredEvidence: Signed sharing matrix plus placement, migration and restart observations. Control allocation, residual gaps and formal decision references.

question: Fabric/multihoming/MTU
requiredEvidence: Approved route schedule and observed RIB/FIB comparison. Packet-size and link/peer-failure results for every offered path.

question: Isolated domain-to-ZIP handoff
requiredOwnerRoles: Network and security-edge engineering; Security-edge engineering
requiredEvidence: Four-domain fixture with no shared-path bypass and exhausted-pool rejection. Bidirectional path traces, intended denials and failover/session evidence.

question: Actual vendor/provider tuples
requiredOwnerRoles: Nutanix platform owner; OpenStack platform owner; Platform and automation engineering; Platform engineering and architecture; VMware/NSX platform owner
requiredEvidence: Supported-operation matrix, actual handoffs, policy and failure results. Current vendor-backed low-level design plus route-propagation and Edge-failure tests. Default-policy, port authority, relocation, gateway and volume-isolation results. Witnessed lifecycle and failure reconciliation, not a provider-name checkbox. Dated compatibility record and qualified lifecycle results.

question: Management/bootstrap/trust
requiredOwnerRoles: Foundation/management owner; Identity, PKI and key owners; Management and identity owners
requiredEvidence: Actual role/route review and approved production-path-loss exercise. Recovery from primary platform unavailability and revoked temporary access. Rotation, revocation and outage/restore results with retained-data recovery.

question: Offered families and service protocols
requiredOwnerRoles: Name/address service owner; Network/platform engineering; Shared-service architects
requiredEvidence: Positive/negative family-specific results; no fabricated IPv4 for IPv6-only. UDP, TCP and truncation/fallback checks plus forbidden-resolver denial. Service consumption and administrative-denial tests in failure conditions.

question: Storage/protection/recovery
requiredOwnerRoles: Backup and recovery owners; Continuity and data owners; Storage and data owners
requiredEvidence: Foreign attachment/export denials and retained-copy disposal accounting. Recover useful test data and demonstrate isolation before reconnecting. Observed site/partition recovery with measured objectives and safe failback.

question: Delivery tooling and ownership
requiredOwnerRoles: Automation/platform owners; Existing service and platform owners; Platform and automation engineering; Provisioning and security-edge owners; Provisioning/service owners
requiredEvidence: Each dependency has an accepted handoff; no borrowed broad credentials. Witnessed lifecycle and failure reconciliation, not a provider-name checkbox. Interrupted-stage and failed-live-check exercises preserve unrelated services. No concurrent competing writers or duplicate allocation after timeout. Reviewed non-destructive plan, rollback boundary and service checks.

question: Service/capacity parameters
requiredOwnerRoles: Capacity and platform owners; Service/data owners
requiredEvidence: Approved service envelope with binding bottleneck and growth trigger. Approved values and test method; no unspecified production promise.

question: Qualification/operating authority
requiredOwnerRoles: Assurance engineering; Operations/service management; Security authority and service owners
requiredEvidence: All mandatory observations supported; blocked/not-run never count as pass. Control allocation, residual gaps and formal decision references. Accepted handover, credential review and scoped incident exercise.

question: Extension service scope
requiredEvidence: Approved scope and complete applicable extension qualification.
